_comment: Brian Singing preset candidates (Phase 2). Each maps to phase2_battery.py knobs. 'preferred' to be set after Brian auditions outputs/phase2/. pitch_shift null = auto (score median matched to Brian's speech median).

Brian_Singing_Rock.notes: higher cfg = tighter, more score-faithful and forceful

Brian_Singing_Emotional.notes: sustain score exercises vibrato; seed 7 chosen as variation

knob_guide.cfg: 1.5 loose/natural ... 3 default ... 5 tight/forceful; also trades expressiveness against score fidelity
knob_guide.pitch_shift: semitones, absolute against score; null lets auto_shift match Brian's register; C_pitch_* battery shows -7..+2 range
knob_guide.n_steps: 16 is 2x faster with small quality cost (E_steps_16 vs A_ref_full)
knob_guide.seed: changes phrasing/micro-timing; B_seed_* show the spread
knob_guide.reference_excerpt: A_ref_full vs A_ref_early vs A_ref_late — pick whichever holds Brian's timbre best
